scorecard.name: Signal source mix
scorecard.key_number: 74.0% of counted conversions come from browser tags
scorecard.why: 208 of 281 counted conversions came from site tags (Website phone calls, Booking form submit, Tap to call on site); 62 were calls from ads measured inside Google and 11 came from uploads. Over 40% browser-tag share is partial.

scorecard.name: Server-side and matched data
scorecard.why: Customer data terms are accepted and enhanced conversions for leads is on, but only 11 of 281 counted conversions arrived by upload in 30 days. The upload summary shows 14 events in total, status NEEDS_ATTENTION, last upload 2026-10-14. Under 10% for a business whose jobs are booked and paid offline is partial. Google's upload summaries don't count enhanced conversions for leads sent through the tag (only the Google Ads diagnostics screen shows those), so the tag side of it can't be measured here.

scorecard.name: Consent
scorecard.why: Tag Manager isn't connected for this business, so consent settings and server-side tagging can't be read. Customers are US only, so EU consent rules don't apply.

scorecard.name: First-party audiences
scorecard.key_number: 0 Customer Match lists; largest list 870 users on Search
scorecard.why: 15 audience lists exist, none built from the company's own customer or lead list, and none reaches the 1,000 users Search needs. 4 are retired similar-audience lists.

scorecard.name: Targeting dependency
scorecard.why: All 8 campaigns with spend are search campaigns targeted by keywords, and no audience is attached anywhere. A search query needs no cookie.

scorecard.name: Measurement resilience
scorecard.why: Smart Bidding (Maximize Conversions and Target CPA) runs on $12,840 of $14,220, and it learns from a signal that is 74.0% browser tags (pillar 1 partial). No second source (GA4, CRM or finance data) is connected to check it against.
